title: spec: declare an author-settable row ceiling for gallery (and kanban) view configs — the protocol lacks the knob objectui#7390 was ruled to read (principle: 协议不正确的先改协议)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #21, `session_01QVMnxyWBx8cAQMsV6akDV9`) executing the maintainer's principle, verbatim and untranslated: 「我们的项目以objectstack 协议为准，文档应该以实际实现为准。协议不正确的应该先修改协议。」 (director chat, 2026-09-10T11:0xZ). Routed `domain:spec` by the anchoring rule; `pm:queue`. ⛔ Not claimed.

## Why this is a protocol change first

objectui#7390 is ruled C: an author-settable row ceiling for the gallery view (`$top: limit ?? default`, plus a visible truncation footnote). Measured on `origin/main` `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `GalleryConfigSchema` (`:945`) is a strictObject of exactly `coverField` · `coverFit` · `cardSize` · `titleField` · `visibleFields`; `KanbanConfigSchema` (`:1241`) is exactly `groupByField` · `summarizeField` · `columns`. Neither declares a row ceiling. objectui already reads a ceiling on kanban (`ObjectKanbanSchema.limit`, declared in `@object-ui/types` only) and on timeline (its own props interface) — consumer-local author-settable keys the protocol never declared, which is the divergence the third clause forbids. ⇒ The knob enters the protocol first; objectui#7390 blocks on this card, and the kanban/timeline consumer-only keys are brought under the same declaration.

## Deliverable

- Declare the row ceiling in `@objectstack/spec` for the view kinds that page-shaped consumers cap by author choice: gallery and kanban at minimum (timeline if spec declares a timeline config), with a describe stating the default and that the renderer must show a visible truncation signal when it applies. Name and placement are the spec seat's (a shared `limit` on those config schemas is the smallest shape; a base view-config member is the alternative — say which and why).
- The non-grid four (gantt / calendar / map / tree) keep objectui#7210's platform ceiling; ⛔ this card does not touch them.
- `Clause-②: yes` (a new authorable key on a published, strict schema); changeset `minor`; the authorable-surface ledger (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`) gains the rows.
- Unlock for objectui#7390 is the installable release, not the merge.

Refs: objectui#7390 (ruling 5615809797 and its amendment), objectui#7210, ADR-0021.
